services.title: Child Vaccination
services.description: Keep your child's immunisation on track without the hospital hassle. We follow the Indian Government (NIS) vaccine schedule from birth to 12 years. The nurse brings everything needed — sterile, safe, and gentle.

services.title: Tetanus Shot
services.description: A nurse administers your tetanus vaccine at home — after an injury, as a booster, or during pregnancy. All three types available: TT, Td, TDaP. A doctor confirms the right one for your case.

services.title: Adult Vaccination
services.description: Stay protected with vaccines like flu shot, typhoid, hepatitis A & B, HPV (cervical cancer), pneumococcal, and more — all administered safely at your home by a trained nurse.

services.title: Rabies Vaccine (Post-Exposure)
services.description: A nurse gives you the anti-rabies vaccination (ARV) at home after a dog bite, monkey scratch, or any animal exposure. We use Rabipur or Verorab. Day 0, 3, 7, 14 schedule. First dose included.

services.title: Antibiotic Injection
services.description: A nurse comes home and administers your prescribed antibiotic injection — into the muscle or vein. Faster than tablets and more effective when the infection needs quick treatment.

services.title: Pain Relief Injection
services.description: A quick injection that relieves pain within minutes — commonly used for back pain, joint pain, period pain, or recovery after surgery. Works faster and stronger than oral painkillers.

services.title: Diclofenac / Pain & Fever Injection
services.description: A fast-acting painkiller and fever-reducer injected into the muscle — starts working within 20 minutes. Used for severe back pain, joint pain, dental pain, post-operative pain, or high fever that oral medicines aren't controlling.

services.title: Anti-Inflammatory Injection
services.description: A corticosteroid injection that quickly reduces swelling, redness, and pain — used for allergic reactions, joint inflammation, asthma flare-ups, or skin conditions.

services.title: Vitamin & Nutrition Injection
services.description: Get Vitamin B12, iron, or other nutrients injected directly — absorbed much better than oral supplements. Often recommended when you feel fatigued, anaemic, or have a deficiency your doctor has identified.

services.title: Vitamin B12 Injection
services.description: A quick IM shot of methylcobalamin (Vitamin B12) — absorbed far better than oral tablets. Recommended for fatigue, nerve tingling, anaemia, or deficiency confirmed by a blood test. Often prescribed for diabetics on metformin, vegetarians, and the elderly.

services.title: IVF Injection
services.description: Fertility protocol injections at home — stimulation (FSH/hMG), trigger shot (hCG), or luteal progesterone support. Nurse follows your IVF doctor's prescription exactly.

services.title: Wound Dressing
services.description: A nurse cleans your wound, applies the right dressing, and makes sure it's healing properly — for cuts, scrapes, abrasions, or any minor injury. Much safer than self-dressing at home.

services.title: Post-Surgery Wound Care
services.description: Specialised dressing and care for surgical wounds after an operation — so you can recover at home without repeated hospital visits. The nurse checks for signs of infection and changes the dressing properly.

services.title: Diabetic Wound Care
services.description: Diabetic wounds heal slowly and can worsen quickly without proper care. A trained nurse comes to clean, dress, and monitor your foot ulcer or chronic wound — reducing the risk of infection and complications.

services.title: Burn Wound Dressing
services.description: Minor to moderate burns need careful cleaning and proper dressing to prevent infection and speed healing. A nurse comes to your home to treat the burn wound safely and change the dressing as needed.

services.title: Stitch Removal
services.description: Once your wound has healed, a nurse comes to remove your stitches or staples carefully at home — no hospital trip needed. Quick, painless, and done under clean conditions.

services.title: Bedsore / Pressure Wound Care
services.description: Bedsores (pressure ulcers) form on the skin of bedridden patients and worsen quickly without proper care. A trained nurse cleans the wound, applies medical dressings, and educates the family on prevention — helping the patient heal comfortably at home.

services.title: Catheter Insertion (Male)
services.description: When a man cannot urinate naturally — due to surgery, prostate issues, or injury — a soft tube is gently inserted by a trained nurse to drain urine comfortably. Done with full privacy and sterile technique at your home.

services.title: Catheter Insertion (Female)
services.description: When a woman cannot urinate naturally — after surgery or due to illness — a trained female nurse gently inserts a soft tube to drain urine comfortably and safely at home. Done with full privacy and sterile care.

services.title: Catheter Maintenance
services.description: If someone already has a catheter in place, a nurse comes to clean it, change the urine collection bag, and check everything is working properly — keeping the patient comfortable and infection-free.

services.title: Catheter Removal
services.description: When your doctor says it's time to remove the catheter, a nurse comes home to take it out safely and comfortably — no need to go back to the hospital just for this.

services.title: Catheter Replacement
services.description: Long-term catheters need to be replaced every 4–6 weeks to prevent infection. A trained nurse removes the old catheter and inserts a new one using sterile technique — so the patient stays comfortable and safe at home without a hospital visit.

services.title: NG Tube Insertion
services.description: A soft, thin tube is passed through the nose into the stomach to deliver liquid food or medicine to patients who cannot eat or swallow normally — commonly needed after strokes, surgeries, or serious illness.

services.title: Enema (Female)
services.description: Professional enema administration at home for female patients — glycerin, phosphate (Fleet), tap water, or oil retention as required.

services.title: Enema (Male)
services.description: Professional enema administration at home for male patients — glycerin, phosphate (Fleet), tap water, or oil retention as required.

services.title: Home Nebulisation
services.description: A nurse brings a nebuliser to your home and administers your prescribed bronchodilator (e.g. Budecort, Duolin) as a fine mist you breathe in — opening the airways within minutes. Ideal for asthma attacks, COPD flare-ups, or persistent wheeze and breathlessness.

services.title: IV Hydration Drip
services.description: A nurse comes home and sets up a drip to deliver fluids and electrolytes directly into your vein — much faster than drinking water. Ideal when you're severely dehydrated from vomiting, fever, diarrhoea, or heat.

services.title: IV Pantoprazole Drip
services.description: An IV drip that reduces stomach acid quickly — used when you have severe acidity, gastritis, or a stomach ulcer and oral medicines are not enough. Works faster than tablets.

services.title: IV Anti-Nausea Drip
services.description: Feeling very nauseous or vomiting constantly? This IV drip stops nausea and vomiting within minutes — more effective than oral anti-nausea tablets when you can't keep anything down.

services.title: IV Multivitamin Drip
services.description: A drip that delivers Vitamin C, B-complex, and essential micronutrients directly into your bloodstream — bypassing the gut for maximum absorption. Great for fatigue, immunity, or recovery after illness.

services.title: IV Diuretic Drip (Furosemide)
services.description: A diuretic drip that helps your body get rid of excess fluid — used when swelling in the legs, ankles, or lungs is causing discomfort. Commonly given at home after a hospital stay for heart or kidney conditions.

services.title: IV Iron Sucrose Infusion
services.description: Slow IV drip for iron-deficiency anaemia. Nurse administers Iron Sucrose (500 mg) diluted in 100 ml Normal Saline with vital monitoring throughout.

services.title: IV Line Removal
services.description: A certified nurse visits your home to safely remove your IV cannula or peripheral line. Takes about 15 minutes — no need to travel to a hospital just for this.

services.title: General Physician at Home
services.description: A nurse visits with a full vitals kit — BP, SpO2, temperature, blood glucose. A verified GP joins live via video, examines you through the nurse's assessment, diagnoses, and issues a digital prescription. Covers fever, infections, body pain, cough, stomach issues, and general illness.

services.title: Chronic Disease Review
services.description: For patients managing diabetes, hypertension, thyroid disorders, or other long-term conditions. A nurse takes a full vitals assessment and records current readings — an Internal Medicine specialist reviews everything live via video, adjusts medications, and sends an updated prescription.

services.title: Paediatric Consultation at Home
services.description: For infants, toddlers, and children up to 12 years. A nurse trained in paediatric assessments visits your home — a paediatrician joins live via video to evaluate fever, infections, breathing issues, rashes, or growth concerns. No stressful clinic trip for your child.

services.title: Women's Health Consult
services.description: A private video consultation with a verified gynaecologist — menstrual irregularities, PCOS, pregnancy guidance, perimenopause, contraception, hormonal concerns, or any women's health question. Conducted discreetly from home. Digital prescription if required.

services.title: Kidney & Nephrology Consult
services.description: Video consultation with a nephrologist for CKD monitoring, elevated creatinine, proteinuria, kidney stones, or dialysis guidance. Pair with a home creatinine blood draw at the same visit for a complete kidney review.

services.title: Dental Advice Consult
services.description: Video consultation with a dentist for tooth pain, sensitivity, gum problems, cavity assessment, wisdom tooth concerns, or post-procedure queries. The dentist reviews your photos and X-rays, advises treatment, and refers you to a clinic for in-person work if needed.

services.title: Prescription Renewal
services.description: Need a refill on a regular medication? A doctor reviews your existing prescription and medication history, and issues a renewed digital prescription within 30 minutes — no clinic visit needed. Fully refunded if renewal is not clinically appropriate.

services.title: ECG at Home (12-Lead)
services.description: A certified nurse visits your home, records a full 12-lead ECG using a portable machine, and sends the digital trace to a cardiologist. Written report delivered within 2 hours.

services.title: Complete Blood Count (CBC)
services.description: Home blood draw for a full CBC — checks haemoglobin, WBC, platelets, RBC indices. Useful for anaemia, infection, and routine health screening. Digital report within 6 hours.

services.title: Blood Glucose (FBS / PPBS)
services.description: Fasting Blood Sugar (FBS) or Post-Prandial Blood Sugar (PPBS) home draw. Essential for diabetes diagnosis and monitoring. Report within 4 hours.

services.title: HbA1c (Glycated Haemoglobin)
services.description: Measures 3-month average blood sugar — the gold-standard test for diabetes management and diagnosis. No fasting required. Report within 6 hours.

services.title: Lipid Profile
services.description: Comprehensive cholesterol panel: Total Cholesterol, HDL, LDL, VLDL, and Triglycerides. Key for heart disease risk assessment. 12-hour fasting required. Report within 6 hours.

services.title: TSH (Thyroid Stimulating Hormone)
services.description: Thyroid screening test — detects hypothyroidism and hyperthyroidism. No fasting needed. Report within 6 hours.

services.title: Vitamin B12 (Serum)
services.description: Measures B12 levels — identifies deficiency causing fatigue, nerve problems, and anaemia. No fasting required. Report within 6 hours.

services.title: Vitamin D (25-OH)
services.description: Measures Vitamin D3 levels — the most common deficiency in urban India. Low levels linked to bone loss, fatigue, and immunity issues. Report within 6 hours.

services.title: Creatinine & eGFR (Kidney Function)
services.description: Measures serum creatinine and estimates Glomerular Filtration Rate (eGFR) — the standard kidney function check. Important for patients on long-term medications. Report within 6 hours.

services.title: Liver Function Tests (LFT)
services.description: Comprehensive liver panel: SGOT, SGPT, ALP, bilirubin, albumin, and total protein. Used for hepatitis monitoring, medication safety, and liver disease screening. Report within 6 hours.

services.title: Urine Routine & Microscopy
services.description: Complete urine analysis: colour, pH, protein, glucose, ketones, RBC, WBC, casts. Screens for UTI, kidney disease, and diabetes. Nurse collects a mid-stream sample at home. Report within 4 hours.
